title: आईने की मुस्कुराती परछाईं का खौफनाक सच! | रात के किस्से
description:
क्या आपका आईना सच में वही दिखाता है जो आपके सामने है? कभी-कभी आईने में दिखने वाली परछाईं आपकी अपनी नहीं होती, बल्कि किसी अनजाने साये की होती है।

मीरा ने पुरानी हवेली से एक एंटीक आईना खरीदा, लेकिन उसे क्या पता था कि उस आईने के अंदर एक 100 साल पुराना भयानक राज़ छुपा है। जब उसकी अपनी ही परछाईं आईने के अंदर मुस्कुराने लगी, तो उसकी ज़िंदगी एक खौफनाक सपने में बदल गई।

ऐसी ही रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाली हॉरर और थ्रिलर कहानियों के लिए हमारे चैनल 'रात के किस्से' को अभी सब्सक्राइब करें!

#HindiHorrorStories #HorrorStoriesInHindi #RaatKeKisse #Aaina #GhostStories

characters.Meera: Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्या आईना सच में वही दिखाता है जो सामने होता है? मीरा को उस रात पता चला, नहीं।
scenes.visual: Indian woman Meera in old haveli bedroom at night, large antique mirror, oil lamp, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Meera standing before a tall antique mirror in a dimly lit haveli bedroom, holding a small brass oil lamp in her trembling hand.
Meera leaning closer to the carved wooden mirror frame, her eyes widening as the flickering lamp casts eerie shadows across the bedroom walls.
Meera stepping backward in shock onto the stone floor, her oil lamp tilting as she gazes at her strange reflection in the night.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: पुरानी हवेली से खरीदा आईना उसने अपने कमरे में टाँगा था।
scenes.visual: Antique carved mirror being hung on a wall in Indian home, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Meera lifting a heavy ornate antique mirror with carved wooden borders, carefully mounting it against the plaster wall of her haveli room.
Meera adjusting the hanging cords of the large antique mirror on the wall, stepping back to check its position in the room.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: पहली रात आईने में उसकी परछाईं आधा सेकंड देर से हिली।
scenes.visual: Meera raising hand, reflection lagging slightly, dim light, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Meera raising her right hand near her shoulder in front of the mirror, the dim oil lamp illuminating her green saree.
Medium shot of Meera keeping her hand still in the air while the glass reflection lags behind, moving a fraction of a second later.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उसने सोचा, थकान होगी। पर दूसरी रात परछाईं मुस्कुरा रही थी, और मीरा नहीं।
scenes.visual: Reflection smiling while Meera stares in fear, lamp flicker, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Meera rubbing her forehead with one hand near her bedside table, brushing off her unease under the warm glow of an oil lamp.
On the following night, Meera standing stiffly before the antique mirror with a frightened, pale expression on her lips in the shadowy room.
Wide shot of Meera watching in terror as the reflection inside the glass curls into a broad, chilling smile while her real lips stay unmoving.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उसने आईने पर कपड़ा डाल दिया और सो गई।
scenes.visual: Cloth draped over mirror, Meera in bed, moonlight through window, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Meera hurriedly tossing a large dark cloth over the tall carved mirror, completely covering the reflective glass inside the dim room.
Meera lying in a wooden bed under white sheets, clutching her pillow while pale moonlight streams across the covered mirror in the corner.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सुबह कपड़ा फ़र्श पर पड़ा था, और आईने के अंदर से किसी ने उँगली से लिखा था, मेरी बारी।
scenes.visual: Fogged mirror with finger-written words, cloth on floor, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Morning light entering the bedroom where the dark cloth lies crumpled on the cold stone floor beneath the antique mirror.
Meera approaching the exposed mirror in horror, noticing thick mist and vapor coating the interior surface of the antique glass.
Medium shot of Meera staring at finger-drawn scratch marks etched across the foggy interior glass from the inside, backing away in utter panic.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: मीरा भागकर पुराने नौकर के पास गई। उसने काँपकर कहा, यह आईना हर सौ साल में एक नई परछाईं माँगता है।
scenes.visual: Old servant in courtyard at dawn, frightened, Meera listening, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Meera running through the arched stone corridors of the old haveli at dawn, clutching her green saree as she rushes outside.
Meera rushing up to an elderly white-haired servant sweeping the paved courtyard, clutching his shoulder with frantic gestures.
The elderly servant dropping his broom onto the stones, gesturing with trembling hands toward the mansion as Meera listens in terror.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: तब तक मीरा की अपनी परछाईं ज़मीन पर कहीं दिखाई नहीं दे रही थी।
scenes.visual: Meera standing in sunlight with no shadow on ground, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Meera walking into the bright morning sunlit courtyard, looking down in panic at the empty sunlit flagstones beneath her feet.
Wide shot of the courtyard where pillars cast long distinct shadows, but Meera stands completely shadowless on the bright stone pavement.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और दूर कमरे में, आईने के भीतर, एक दूसरी मीरा हाथ हिला रही थी।
scenes.visual: Mirror in dark room showing a second Meera waving, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Camera looking into the dark, empty bedroom from the doorway, focusing on the ornate antique mirror standing upright against the wall.
Medium shot of the mirror interior where a duplicate figure of Meera stands inside the glass, slowly waving her hand outwards into darkness.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आगे क्या हुआ? पूरी कहानी देखने के लिए नीचे दिए गए वीडियो पर क्लिक करें!
scenes.visual: Dark haveli at night with one lit window, Indian woman, 30, long black hair, green saree, anxious eyes
shots: Wide exterior view of the sprawling ancient haveli at night under dark stormy clouds, with only a single upper window glowing amber.
A silhouette of a woman standing motionless behind the lit arched window of the ancient mansion, looking out into the pitch-black courtyard below.
